reason: MailMessage.Body/IsHtmlBody are kept but marked Obsolete (warning only, not compile error) while the SMTP/Azure providers now ignore them entirely in favor of new TextBody/HtmlBody properties, so any downstream module/tenant code still setting message.Body directly will silently send emails with an empty body with no compiler error to alert them.
